words_to_learn.en: for a year, until next year

lines.en: The shepherd plays, mother, the shepherd plays,

lines.cyr: овчар свири доле в' поле, де.
lines.lat: ovčar sviri dole v' pole, de.
lines.en: the shepherd plays down in the field, hey.

lines.cyr: Доле в' поле, мамо, доле в' поле,
lines.lat: Dole v' pole, mamo, dole v' pole,
lines.en: Down in the field, mother, down in the field,
down in the field, in the meadow.

lines.cyr: Јас ќе одам мамо, јас ќе одам,
lines.lat: Jas ḱe odam mamo, jas ḱe odam,
lines.en: I will go, mother, I will go,

lines.cyr: јас ќе одам доле в' поле де.
lines.lat: jas ḱe odam dole v' pole de.
lines.en: I will go down to the field, hey.

lines.cyr: Да ме чекаш мамо, да ме чекаш,
lines.lat: Da me čekaš mamo, da me čekaš,
lines.en: Wait for me, mother, wait for me,

lines.cyr: да ме чекаш до година де.
lines.lat: da me čekaš do godina de.
lines.en: wait for me for a year, hey.
For a year, mother, for a year,

lines.cyr: до година с' младо момче де.
lines.lat: do godina s' mlado momče de.
lines.en: for a year, with a young lad, hey.

lines.cyr: С' младо момче мамо, с' младо момче,
lines.lat: S' mlado momče mamo, s' mlado momče,
lines.en: With a young lad, mother, with a young lad,

lines.cyr: с' младо момче, со машко дете.
lines.lat: s' mlado momče, so maško dete.
lines.en: with a young lad, a male child.
